findings.contract_clause: SERVICE.md: Inputs — the crypto inventory manifest
findings.detail: The atom returned a 200 OK status for malformed input (system=12345, inventory='not-a-list') instead of a 422 Unprocessable Entity error.

notes: The atom correctly implements the logic for classification and status reporting. However, it fails to enforce input schema validation, returning a 200 status for malformed input instead of the required 422.
